metadata.reconciliation_note: BND and BIL event facts are bound to captured issuer sources on 2026-10-22: Vanguard BND product-page distribution table (sha256 d09560f58834be2b1297f782969410aba07adab08f1a537a366f3dcd916d3abd) and the SSGA SPDR historical-distributions workbook (sha256 6b65cbf956b5d25705d08470006a0e97e6a7d2a0d5cfd08b63f6f79783b06320). Confirmed rows carry metadata-level source_row_ref and capture evidence, NOT a cryptographic seal of the issuer artifact. Publication vintage and revision policy remain UNKNOWN.
